Chapter V

Poems

Post Laureate

—Courtesy The Cardinal, Savoy High School Annual.

MARTHA BUFORD MAY
Post Laureate

A tireless worker in the development of the student association. She has served not only as secretary-treasurer but has filled numerous places of an emergency nature, in making the annual reunions pleasant and successful. She is a gifted product of the old school, as evidenced by her ability to produce from time to time a poem, a song or other literary contribution of high merit. In recognition of this talent she was elected (1940) as poet laureate of the association.
